preconditions.description: The size of the first part of the bipartite graph must be between 1 and 1000.
The size of the second part of the bipartite graph must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of edges in the graph must be between 0 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= a and 1 <= y <= b for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect a vertex from the first part to a vertex from the second part within their respective bounds.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must contain the minimal number of colours used.
The second line of output must contain exactly m integers representing the colours of the edges.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(colour) <= c for colour in stdout.splitlines()[1].split())
postconditions.description: Each colour assigned to the edges must be between 1 and the minimal number of colours c.
